title: Recover Robot Visibility After Restart When It Cannot See a Label (Flashing Blue to Solid Blue/Solid Green)
summary: If a robot is restarted while stopped between two labels, it may not snap back onto the map because it cannot see a label. Use the source-described recovery: perform a system E stop, physically push the robot onto the label, then clear the E stop and verify the robot indicator transitions from flashing blue to solid blue and then to solid green, and that the robot becomes visible on the map.
when_to_use: Use when, after a robot restart, the robot does not snap back onto the map automatically because it cannot see a label, indicated by the robot showing a flashing blue sign/indicator.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: perform the physical recovery actions (system E stop, push the robot onto the label, clear the E stop) and observe the robot indicator color transition and map visibility.
safety_notes: This procedure includes physical system E stop and walking into the floor area to push the robot onto the label; only perform if you can do so safely.
access_or_tools_needed: Physical E stop access (as referenced by the source)
Physical access to the robot on the floor
Robot indicator/sign showing flashing blue / solid blue / solid green
Map display to verify robot visibility

system_preconditions: Robot has been restarted and is not snapping back onto the map automatically because it is stopped between two labels.

visual_references.description: Restart recovery segment showing the flashing blue -> solid blue -> solid green indicator behavior and the map visibility outcome.

steps.title: Check whether the robot snaps back onto the map after restart
steps.purpose: Confirm the specific post-restart symptom that triggers the recovery (robot not appearing on the map automatically).
steps.instruction: After restarting the robot, check the map display to see whether the robot snaps back onto the map automatically.
steps.expected_result: The robot is not positioned/visible on the map automatically after the restart (robot appears missing/not positioned).
steps.healthy_condition: The robot appears on the map after restart without needing physical recovery.
steps.failure_condition: The robot does not appear on the map after restart and you suspect it is stopped between two labels.

actions.label: Verify map visibility after restart
actions.exact_action: Check whether the robot is not snapping back onto the map automatically.

steps.title: Identify the flashing blue indicator that means the robot cannot see a label
steps.purpose: Confirm the indicator state that the source ties to label recognition failure between labels.
steps.instruction: Look for the robot indicator/sign state described by the source as flashing blue.
steps.expected_result: The robot shows a flashing blue sign/indicator.
steps.healthy_condition: The robot shows solid blue or solid green (indicating it has picked up/identified a label or completed the restart cycle).
steps.failure_condition: The robot does not show the expected flashing blue state while still not visible on the map (may require escalation).

actions.label: Check robot indicator color
actions.exact_action: Look for the flashing blue sign/indicator.

steps.title: Perform the source-described recovery: E stop the system and push the robot onto the label
steps.purpose: Force the robot into a position where it can see/identify the label so it can lock onto it.
steps.instruction: If flashing blue is present, perform the source-described recovery: E stop the system, walk into the floor area, and push the robot onto the label.
steps.expected_result: After pushing the robot onto the label, the robot begins the label identification process (indicator should progress toward solid blue).
steps.healthy_condition: Robot is physically positioned on the label area so it can identify the label.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot safely perform the physical action (E stop + pushing the robot onto the label), or the robot still does not progress toward solid blue after being placed on the label.

actions.label: Push robot onto the label
actions.exact_action: push the robot onto the label.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if you cannot safely perform the source-described physical action (E stop + pushing the robot onto the label).

steps.title: Verify the robot locks onto the label (indicator transitions to solid blue)
steps.purpose: Confirm that the robot has identified the label and locked onto it, as described by the source.
steps.instruction: After pushing the robot onto the label, observe the robot indicator transition from flashing blue to solid blue.
steps.expected_result: The robot transitions from flashing blue to solid blue, indicating it has picked up the label.
steps.healthy_condition: Solid blue is observed after the robot is placed on the label.
steps.failure_condition: Indicator does not transition from flashing blue to solid blue after the robot is pushed onto the label.

actions.label: Observe indicator transition
actions.exact_action: go from flashing blue to solid blue

stop_or_escalate_if: If the indicator does not transition as described (flashing blue -> solid blue -> solid green) or the robot still does not appear on the map, escalate for further troubleshooting.

steps.title: Clear the E stop and confirm the robot is successfully showing on the map
steps.purpose: Restore normal operation and verify the map visibility outcome.
steps.instruction: Clear the E stop and then check the map to confirm the robot is successfully showing on the map.
steps.expected_result: After clearing the E stop, the robot becomes visible successfully on the map.
steps.healthy_condition: Robot appears on the map after E stop is cleared.
steps.failure_condition: Robot still does not appear on the map after clearing the E stop.

actions.label: Confirm map visibility
actions.exact_action: you'll see the robot being successfully showing successful on the map itself

stop_or_escalate_if: If the indicator does not transition as described (flashing blue -> solid blue -> solid green) or the robot still does not appear on the map, escalate for further troubleshooting.

steps.title: Observe the full color transition to solid green and wait before moving if needed
steps.purpose: Ensure the restart cycle completes and the robot is safe/ready to move, per the source’s brake-lock behavior.
steps.instruction: Observe the color transition: flashing blue -> solid blue -> solid green. If the robot is solid green but not on a label, wait until it turns green before moving it because the brakes stay locked.
steps.expected_result: The robot reaches solid green, and if it is solid green but not on a label, it is not moved until it turns green (brakes stay locked).
steps.healthy_condition: Solid green is reached; movement is delayed until the source-indicated green readiness state when brakes are locked.
steps.failure_condition: Moving the robot while brakes are still locked (before it turns green as instructed) or the indicator sequence does not complete.

actions.label: Confirm indicator sequence
actions.exact_action: It will go from flashing blue to solid blue... Once it's solid green

actions.label: Wait before moving if brakes are locked
actions.exact_action: wait till it turns green for you to move it because the brakes stay locked.

stop_or_escalate_if: If the indicator does not transition as described (flashing blue -> solid blue -> solid green) or the robot still does not appear on the map, escalate for further troubleshooting.

success_criteria: Robot reacquires a label and transitions from flashing blue to solid blue.
Robot reaches solid green as part of the restart cycle.
Robot becomes visible successfully on the map after clearing the E stop.
healthy_conditions: Robot indicator transitions in order: flashing blue -> solid blue -> solid green.
Robot appears on the map after clearing the E stop.
Operator waits until the robot turns green before moving when brakes are locked.
failure_conditions: Robot does not snap back onto the map automatically after restart.
Flashing blue is present and the robot does not transition to solid blue after being pushed onto the label.
After clearing the E stop, the robot still does not appear on the map.
Indicator sequence does not follow flashing blue -> solid blue -> solid green.
escalation_guidance: Stop and escalate if you cannot safely perform the source-described physical action (E stop + pushing the robot onto the label).
If the indicator does not transition as described (flashing blue -> solid blue -> solid green) or the robot still does not appear on the map, escalate for further troubleshooting.
